title: A Revolutionized way of cooking!
body: I’m impressed! This is no ordinary app, I’ve cooked countless recipes and I can’t stop! Foodie makes it so easy to cook even a 5th grader can do it! What’s more important is that even if you don’t have a recipe that you see within Foodie, you can import your own. The crazy part is that you can even have the app cook with you as your companion, going along with the recipe! Foodie also becomes your shopping companion with Instacart integration which is a big plus in my book! Time is money and you save both with Foodie!

title: Best recipe app!!

title: FINALLY! The king of recipe apps has arrived
body: After trying countless recipe apps to organize everything I save from social media, random browsing, and word of mouth, Foodie has truly changed the game. It takes the mental load out of recipes, meal planning, and grocery shopping. Saving is effortless. I just share a recipe to the app and it's stored. One of my favorite features is the search! I can search by ingredient or recipe name, which none of the other apps I tried could do. You can also create categories (basically separate cookbooks) if you prefer. The video feature is a time saver. Foodie now pulls the actual video from your saved recipe into the app and breaks it into steps, so you can follow along at your own pace. No more replaying and rewinding, and no more smudging my phone with dirty hands to pause. As someone who's always multitasking, this is huge. Having the videos playing on repeat while I move through the steps drove me crazy. Meal planning and grocery lists work great. Add recipes to your plan and it builds your grocery list. You can check off what you already have at home, so you know exactly what you need at the store. The weekly menu emails are a nice bonus for the weeks I don't want to think about it. As a millennial, I LOVE the little rigatoni character (I call him Lil Riggy!). You can chat with him for modifications or substitutions when you're missing an ingredient. I'm still testing how much I can rely on it, but I love him regardless. The creator cooks too. His own recipes are in the app, and the few I've tried were amazing. Five stars. Highly recommend to anyone who's tired of juggling screenshots, bookmarks, and handwritten cards! TLDR; BETTER THAN RECIME

title: Amazing!

title: Best Food Recipe App Ever
body: I love the convenience of having many food options of food recipes in the app, showing you videos of how to cook each step, and being able to help order the exact ingredients and groceries to your door to cook the dish you want to make, and/or adding them to your grocery shopping list. The videos of showing each step of how to cook make it easier to follow when cooking. It’s a great app for beginners that starts to learn how to cook dishes for the first time and try cooking multi-cultural dishes.

title: Such a life saver
body: I’ve been meaning to cook at home more and Foodie has made that transition so effortless. I was even able to adjust recipes for my avocado allergy!

title: Best recipe app out there!
body: The user experience on this app is very thoughtful, detailed, and well-designed. Unlike ReciMe and other similar apps, Foodie is far more functional, intuitive, and interactive. Absolutely worth the subscription!!

title: The most powerful and intuitive cooking app!
body: After trying a few other recipe download apps, I walked away frustrated because they wouldn’t save correctly and were not consistent. How to try this app, and its powerful features, I am blown away. My favorite feature is the “hands-free cooking” because you’re able to see the very helpful video clips from the original source as it guides you step-by-step. The ability to import recipes from various sources is so helpful and the AI is so smart that it is able to fill in the blanks, even if the recipe isn’t fully listed. Can’t wait to continue using this app to expand my cooking repertoire!

title: So much better than the alternatives
body: Recipe import actually works. The design is clean and beautiful. The hands free cooking experience is a game changer.
